description: § 172(b)(2) ordering (derived). Fixture 989's return: the pre-2018 loss absorbs 100,000 − 20% × 70,000 = $86,000 ≥ $30,000 (fully used); the post-2017 loss's modified taxable income counts the pre-2018 deduction: 100,000 − 30,000 = $70,000, less 20% × 70,000 = $56,000 absorbed → carryover 100,000 − 56,000 = $44,000.
